capacity_policy.platform_restrictions: Respect actual provider quotas/tool/context limits; record interruptions and resume without bypass. No obsolete per-study usage percentage is introduced as a mathematical admission rule.

model_policy: Same live-available actual model alias and effort across arms; record served identity/backend when exposed. No immutable served revision is assumed.

research_extension_policy.stop_condition: Complete evaluated portfolio plus substantive improvement attempts, or specific mathematical bottlenecks after serious attempts. No obligation to spend all allowance.
research_extension_policy.technical_session_boundaries: Checkpoint safely and resume aggregate stage; context/provider/tool interruption is never a mathematical failure or an overcap exclusion.

review_policy.format_defects: Mechanical correction allowed with original snapshot/history retained; do not discard assessable mathematics.
review_policy.one_candidate_initially: Candidate plus same permitted original sources and reproducibility evidence; no cross-arm verdict/ranking.
review_policy.repair_and_rereview: Comparable opportunity in every arm/stage; final proof status assessed after actual changes.

scientific_separation.control_workers: No D01 research artifacts or historical candidate solutions.
scientific_separation.coordinator_assisted: If introduced later, separate labeled track; not part of arm comparison.
scientific_separation.fresh_workers: No coordinator master, old combined report, past candidate solutions, coordinator repairs or other-arm results. Native/exposure treatment only differs in permitted project snapshot.
scientific_separation.legacy_workers: Own historical candidates and relevant own feedback only.
scientific_separation.paired_workers: Only same-arm same-replication own D01 artifacts and feedback after comparable review/repair; retain valid D01 floor, then try D02-dependent improvements.
